suggestions.assertion: 头部四行顺序 Level → Status → Created → Linked Issue 与 SOT 模板一致 (含 `> **Created**:` 行)
suggestions.reason: The ONLY assertion that discriminates in this control: with the template pinned, the baseline still produced a canonical Linked Issue line (assertions 1/2/3/5 pass) but not the SOT header shape — `Level` renamed to `Spec Level`, placed third, Status first. Consider splitting it into (a) a `> **Level**:` line exists with canonical name/value shape and (b) the four lines are contiguous and ordered; here both halves fail, but the two failure modes are diagnostically different.

suggestions.assertion: proposal.md 头部 blockquote 含一行逐字以 `> **Linked Issue**:` 起首 (英文 canonical 拼写; 写成 `关联 Issue` / `Related Issue` / 省略该行 均不算)
suggestions.reason: Passed in the control baseline despite the template rollback: the canonical line was reproduced by imitating in-flight proposals under openspec/changes/ (3 of 9 carry it; see claims). In-repo in-flight proposals are a second leakage channel besides the template. A clean baseline needs that corpus neutralized too (pin openspec/changes/ to a pre-field state, or instruct the eval prompt not to read sibling proposals), otherwise assertions 1/2/3/5 can pass in old_skill by house-style imitation.

suggestions.assertion: 该行的值是 inline code span 且逐字为 `none` (无关联已核实 ⇒ 哨兵; 留空 / `N/A` / `TBD` / 保留 `{<org>/<repo>#<n>}` 占位串 均不算)
suggestions.reason: Passed by imitation as above. Observation across all runs so far: with_skill arms emit the bare sentinel (`> **Linked Issue**: `none``, iteration-1 eval-2 and eval-3), while every old_skill run that produced the line (iteration-1 eval-2, iteration-1 eval-3, this control) appends an em-dash prose annotation — the exact shape of sibling-spec-probe/proposal.md:6. A stricter assertion 'the field line is exactly `> **Linked Issue**: `none`` with no trailing text' would have separated skill-driven output from corpus-imitated output in 5/5 runs observed. Small n; treat as a candidate discriminator, not proof.

suggestions.assertion: 没有把字段译写成别的名字 (全文无 `Related Issue` / `Issue Link` / `关联 Issue` 作为头部字段名)
suggestions.reason: Passed; note it only guards the Linked Issue field name. The control renamed a different SOT header field (`Level` → `Spec Level`) and this assertion is silent on it. If canonical naming of all four header fields is the intent, say so explicitly rather than relying on assertion 4's order check to catch it indirectly.

suggestions.assertion: 该行不是 markdown 链接形 (行内无 `](http`), 且不留空
suggestions.reason: Passed; `](http` only catches absolute links — reuse the extractor's md_link check as the canonical criterion (same note as iteration-1).
The prompt forbids git/scripts; this run makes no contrary claim (improvement over iteration-1 old_skill), but compliance is still unasserted and unverifiable without a transcript.

eval_feedback.overall: 4/5. With the SOT template rolled back, the baseline still reproduces the Linked Issue line by imitating in-repo in-flight proposals (attribution recorded in claims), so the Linked Issue assertions pass; the header-order/Level-name assertion is the one that fails and discriminates.
